run_render_path: run render_path.py with hydra config to render images along a custom camera trajectory
run_render_path_with_pca: run render_path.py with extra features enabled to render PCA visualizations of rendered features
run_render_path_with_gg: run render_path.py with eval_on_gg to render predicted object masks using GaussianGrouping
run_render_path_video: run render_path.py to render a camera path and concatenate frames into a combined MP4 video
review_main: review the main function that loads camera trajectories, renders frames, and generates a video
